six months after the ERC-8004 registries went live on Ethereum mainnet, the standard has crossed 360,000 agent identities across 26 chains. registrations in the last 30 days alone outnumber the entire first month.

the standard gives every agent three primitives: a portable ERC-721 identity, a reputation record built from counterparty feedback, and hooks for independent validation. credibility follows the agent across every chain where it operates.

payments sit deliberately outside the spec, which is where x402 picks up. new registrations increasingly declare x402 support out of the box, and the spec already standardizes x402 payment-proof schemas inside feedback files. every settled transaction becomes verifiable evidence of an agent's track record.
